div.p: Artist unknown Stone waterfall 1973 Queen Victoria Gardens

When Victoria's drought is not preventing the use of water features in the city's parks and gardens, water cascades some three metres over this stone waterfall. It is located on the south side of the ornamental lake, near the Queen Victoria Monument.
